claims.text: Role in takotsubo: diuretics for pulmonary edema.
claims.quote: Diuretics are indicated in patients with pulmonary oedema.

claims.text: Furosemide (edema): 20–80 mg PO as a single dose;
claims.quote: The usual initial dose of LASIX is 20 mg to 80mg given as a single dose.

claims.text: repeat or raise by 20–40 mg ⍉sooner than 6–8 h later until the desired diuresis.
claims.quote: The dose may be raised by 20 mg or 40mg and given not sooner than 6 to 8 hours after the previous dose until the desired diuretic effect has been obtained.

claims.text: Interactions (all diuretics): lithium—⍉, diuretics cut its clearance and risk toxicity;
claims.quote: Lithium generally should not be given with diuretics because they reduce lithium’s renal clearance and add a high risk of lithium toxicity.

claims.text: NSAIDs can blunt the diuretic and antiHTN effect of loop, K-sparing and thiazide diuretics.
claims.quote: the administration of a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agent can reduce the diuretic, natriuretic, and antihypertensive effects of loop, potassium-sparing and thiazide diuretics

claims.text: OD: supportive—replace fluid and lyte losses;
claims.quote: Treatment of overdosage is supportive and consists of replacement of excessive fluid and electrolyte losses.

claims.text: check lytes, CO2 and BP often.
claims.quote: Serum electrolytes, carbon dioxide level and blood pressure should be determined frequently.
